parole.testo: From Punjabi دستار / ਦਸਤਾਰ (dastār), from Classical Persian دستار (dastār).

parole.significato: A type of leavened bread from northern India, made with wheat flour and usually eaten with chole.
parole.testo: From Punjabi ਕੁਲਚਾ (kulcā), from Classical Persian کلیچه (kulīča), کلچه (kolča). Doublet of kulich.

parole.significato: A Muslim man; especially one from Pakistan.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Punjabi ਸੁੱਲਾ (sullā, “Muslim (derogatory)”). This word is likely a mispronunciation (or perhaps a misspelling in Gurmukhi script) of Punjabi ਮੁੱਲਾ (mullā, “mullah, Islamic religious leader”), derived from Classical Persian ملا (mullā), ultimately from Arabic مُلَّا (mullā).
